title: Mr. Funtoosh
desc: Palash, an engineer, returns to the slum he grew up in, much to the delight of his welcoming friends. Things take a turn when a scheming Pratap tricks him into a real-estate project.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.

title: Pradhan
desc: When an honest policeman is transferred to Dharmapur, he encounters widespread corruption and fights to stay true to his principles.

desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.

desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the workers' union.

desc: A powerful landowner conducts his business and lives his life with cruelty. However, various circumstances influence him to change his nature and tactics over time.

desc: Montu, a local thug, and Rina, a doctor, fall in love. However, when Rina's colleague Dr Ranjan tries to destroy their lives, the two lovers decide to fight back.

desc: A family man who has always strived to raise his children well now struggles to cope against his family's humiliation and their dwindling finances.

title: Sahobase
desc: In this compelling story, an unmarried couple navigates life together, facing personal struggles, deception, and arguments, while a hidden mystery unravels, ultimately drawing them closer than ever.

desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Surer Akashe
desc: A man and woman fall in love and decide to get married. Their bliss is dampened when he leaves her without warning after he loses his vision, hoping she will find happiness elsewhere.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tumi Je Amar
desc: When an argument between a husband and wife separates the two for a long time, their sons take certain decisions which bring them back together.

title: Abhimaan
desc: After disowning his daughter years ago, an elderly businessman now seeks the help of his grandson to mend his relationship with her.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Badnam
desc: Mathur Ghosh's cruelty drives Haranath to suicide. Years later, Haranath's son Shankar grows up determined to avenge his father's death by seeking justice against the evil Mathur Ghosh.

title: Manush Keno Beiman
desc: L Chowdhury, a simple villager, who lives with his sister, finds his life turned upside down because of an unexpected accident.
